methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The requirements for such a platform are presented in this paper, along with an overview of the system concept.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents the QuiXel software platform concept and functional requirements for IT support of environmental/energy management in SMEs. No specific EnPI/EnB measurement model is presented or characterised: the KPI capability is a generic, user-configurable formula editor over meter variables, and reference-period comparison is a generic software feature. Tool/software design without EnPI/EnB measurement-model content.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The aim of the QuiXel project is to develop an integrated data and information platform for evolving and collaborative EnvM and EM in small and medium-sized enterprises

stage1.notes: KPIs referenced only as a generic platform capability (user-defined via a formula editor over meter variables); no specific normalisation model, baseline, or variable set is identified. ISO 50001/14001 cited as compliance framing for the software, not as a measurement model.
